feature, refactoring.purpose: Implement the scoped feature or refactor and verify behavior.

bug-fix.purpose: Reproduce the bug, fix its cause, and verify the regression.

perf-issue.purpose: Measure the bottleneck and verify the performance change.

hillclimb.purpose: Optimize against the frozen benchmark and regression gates.

judgment and prose.purpose: Review evidence and communicate a grounded judgment.

hardest tasks.purpose: Solve the assigned difficult task within the parent scope.

how explorer.purpose: Trace the implementation and return source evidence.

how explainer.purpose: Explain the implementation from the supplied evidence.

why investigators.purpose: Investigate the assigned source and cite evidence for decisions.

why synthesizer.purpose: Synthesize motivation from the source investigators.

reflect tooling.purpose: Find concrete tool/workflow problems in the scoped history.

reflect judgment, divergent, synthesizer.purpose: Analyze the assigned history and propose evidence-based lessons.

arena runners.purpose: Produce one independent candidate for the parent arena.

arena cross-judge pool.purpose: Judge the supplied arena candidates independently.

swarm workers.purpose: Complete only the assigned slice and return verification evidence.

architect runners.purpose: Propose one caller-focused design with source evidence.

interrogate reviewers.purpose: Review independently against the supplied intent, diff and rubric.
